parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group.

parameters.name: InnerDomainEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to disable the public second-level domain name.

parameters.name: InternetEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the virtual private cloud (VPC) second-level domain name.

parameters.name: InternetIPV6Enable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable IPv6. Valid values: **true** and **false**.

parameters.name: VpcIntranetEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the VPC domain name. Valid values:

*   TRUE
*   FALSE

parameters.name: VpcSlbIntranetEnable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the self-calling domain name.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi modify-api-group-network-policy --group-id b0162c75d7d34ff48506f1aff878b05e --https-policy HTTPS1_1_TLS1_0 --internet-enable true --internet-ipv6-enable true --vpc-intranet-enable false --vpc-slb-intranet-enable false --inner-domain-enable true --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ModifyApiGroupNetworkPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --InternetEnable true --InternetIPV6Enable true --HttpsPolicy HTTPS1_1_TLS1_0 --InnerDomainEnable true --VpcIntranetEnable false --VpcSlbIntranetEnable false --GroupId b0162c75d7d34ff48506f1aff878b05e
